summary.text: Don Kissick, a Libertarian and Navy veteran, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Governor of Ohio to Amy Acton.
He was previously the Libertarian nominee for Ohio’s 5th Congressional District in 2018 and for U.S. Senate in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Kissick served six years in the U.S. Navy, according to his campaign website, including two deployments to the Middle East during Desert Storm/Desert Shield and Southern Watch.
The site says he moved to Ohio in 2007 and to Ottawa in 2014, and that northwestern Ohio is home to his family.
In 2026 he ran for governor as the Libertarian nominee with running mate James Mills, and he said Ohio needs a government with someone who has "actually punched a clock in their life."
He received 3.3% of the vote to Amy Acton's 52.3%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
